# Technical Transformation Studio

> Senior technical studio in Querétaro, México. Software engineering, AI automation,
> cybersecurity, data engineering & BI, technical delivery, and web & growth.
> Work is delivered under a written scope, in English or Spanish, and handed over
> with the source code, documentation and credentials.

## What it is
- A three-person senior studio: Antonio Garduño (technical director), Samuel González
  (software & automation engineer), Ricardo Vázquez (data engineer & software developer).
- No junior pyramid — you work with the three named people.
- Entry point: a two-week technical assessment (findings + a roadmap you own, no
  commitment to continue).
- Languages: English and Spanish. Remote, based in Querétaro, México.

## Practices
- Software Engineering — internal tools, APIs, integrations and business applications.
- AI & Automation — agentic assistants and reporting automation over your own data,
  with outputs traceable to the source.
- Cybersecurity — scoped web application penetration testing and risk governance,
  under written authorisation.
- Data, Analytics & Engineering — pipelines and orchestration (Airflow), warehousing
  (Snowflake, dbt), dashboards and business intelligence.
- Technical Delivery & Account Leadership — fractional technical program management.
- Web & Growth — conversion-focused websites and landing pages, SEO, analytics, and
  forms wired to a CRM, email or WhatsApp.

## Packages (starting prices in USD; the exact figure follows the assessment)
- Launch — from USD 1,500: two-week assessment plus one quick win.
- Build — from USD 4,500: one system built and handed over (tool, automation or dashboard).
- Transform — from USD 9,000: an integrated system end to end; retainer from USD 1,200/mo.

## Boundaries (stated on the site)
- Not a staffing agency; scope is agreed in writing before work begins.
- Penetration testing is scoped and requires written authorisation and agreed rules of
  engagement — no full-scope red-team, social engineering or physical intrusion.
- Source code, documentation and credentials are handed over; studio access is revoked
  at closure.
